cluster_summary: This cluster contains 25 CVEs where user-controlled input is processed without proper validation, leading to code injection, prototype pollution, stack overflow, infinite loops, ReDoS, and resource exhaustion. The vulnerabilities arise from missing bounds checks, missing escaping, insufficient key validation, and unsafe recursion patterns across various libraries.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-controlled filenames, archive entries, path fragments, or resource names into file read, write, delete, extraction, or resource-loading APIs. Report code paths where the normalized absolute path is not checked to remain under the intended base directory before the file operation. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 5 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should normalize and canonicalize the resolved path, then enforce a base-directory prefix or equivalent containment check.

mechanism.missing_guard: the normalized absolute path is not checked to remain under the intended base directory before the file operation
mechanism.name: path traversal through missing canonical prefix check
mechanism.sink_shape: file read, write, delete, extraction, or resource-loading APIs
mechanism.source_shape: attacker-controlled filenames, archive entries, path fragments, or resource names
mechanism.typical_fix: normalize and canonicalize the resolved path, then enforce a base-directory prefix or equivalent containment check

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Add checks on every segment using a forbidden key set, enforce own-property membership via hasOwnProperty, and skip inherited properties.
sub_patterns.name: Prototype pollution via insufficient key validation in path traversal
sub_patterns.root_cause: Property path segments are not validated against dangerous keys (__proto__, constructor, prototype) at all positions, allowing prototype pollution.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Pre-scan input to determine which paths are pure arrays before construction.
sub_patterns.name: Type confusion from unvalidated array type inference
sub_patterns.root_cause: Parser assumes numeric keys always indicate an array without enforcing all sibling keys to be numeric, leading to mixed array/object types.
